scope.source_scope: canonical master imported from configured Expense Control source provenance

method.rule: missing stays null/missing; no zero-fill; no inferred menu, SKU, quantity, conversion, or unit cost
method.cost_per_serving_formula: sum(recipe quantity converted to canonical unit × canonical unit cost) + sum(packaging quantity × canonical packaging unit cost)
method.selection_rule: Cafe coffee defaults to verified ไม่หวาน when defined; other Cafe menus default to verified ปกติ; Steak defaults only sauce PREP-GRV when exposed, never side/coke
method.fallback_rule: No direct/default/promo cost fallback is accepted by Maple costing.mjs

dataset_audit.source: Expense Control inventoryItems + recipe packaging components

dataset_audit.reason: Heuristic mapping is not accepted for financial truth
Movement is allowed only for complete costing
Older revision than the 2026-09-17 Expense Control source
No central costing domain existed before this import
Explicit menu/SKU/formula update; missing prices remain null

pipeline_findings.reason: Maple previously had sales/inventory aggregates but no canonical Ingredient, Recipe/BOM, Packaging, Unit Cost, or Costing domain.
pipeline_findings.remediation: Read the canonical costing master and use costing.mjs for menu costing and stock deduction.

pipeline_findings.reason: The previous audit only searched Maple paths and reported all costing sources as missing even though configured Expense Control source records existed.
pipeline_findings.remediation: Audit the imported canonical master menu-by-menu and retain source provenance.

pipeline_findings.reason: Batch source uses yieldQty while normalized master uses yield_quantity; nested batch costing previously stopped at a false mapping error.
pipeline_findings.remediation: Normalize both source field names and calculate nested batch cost only when yield unit matches.

pipeline_findings.reason: Legacy GPOS menu mapping has a heuristic fallback; it is not allowed to create financial truth or stock movement without verified mapping.
pipeline_findings.remediation: Keep heuristic matches as review-only and require canonical SKU mapping for posting.

pipeline_findings.reason: The audited legacy Expense Control UI contains operational benchmark COGS fallback paths; this target-only change does not mutate that source repository.
pipeline_findings.remediation: Maple financial reports must use only canonical costing status and null when incomplete.

fixes_applied.detail: Imported normalized Ingredient, Recipe/BOM, Packaging, Unit Cost, Costing, and Stock Mapping into one central artifact.
Added nested batch costing, exact unit-cost lookup, explicit selection handling, and null-on-missing behavior.
Audit now reports the actual menu and component that prevents cost per serving.
Maple costing does not read direct/default/promo costs outside canonical unit_costs.
